01000011122233310213203023 - ASI: 23

Rules:
  00 = 0 * 0
  01 = 0 * 1
  03 = 0 * 3
  11 = 1 * 1
  12 = 1 * 2
  21 = 2 * 1
  23 = 2 * 3
  31 = 3 * 1
  32 = 3 * 2
  021 = 0 * 21
  023 = 0 * 23
  223 = 2 * 23
  331 = 3 * 31
  0100 = 01 * 00
  3203 = 32 * 03
  12223 = 12 * 223
  010000 = 0100 * 00
  331021 = 331 * 021
  1112223 = 11 * 12223
  3203023 = 3203 * 023
  0100001112223 = 010000 * 1112223
  3310213203023 = 331021 * 3203023
  01000011122233310213203023 = 0100001112223 * 3310213203023
